description.value:
You turn your gestalt wildshaping energy inward, forcing long, curved spurs of hardened bone to erupt from your skin at joints, knuckles, elbows, shoulders, and knees.

While this spell is active, when you successfully Grapple a creature, you deal 3d6 piercing damage to that creature in addition to the Grapple's effects, and at the start of each of your turns while you have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed}, that creature takes 2d6 piercing damage.
